SimulationCPUE_3d_Winker2014_cluster.R is the original 2014 cluster simulator.
OMcpueSIM22_original.R and Generate_scenario_data22_original.R are the original
four-species Run 22 bathymetric operating model and data generator. These
source files are retained unchanged as provenance and references. The package
provides callable implementations with package-managed dependencies and ggplot2
figures.
